description: Create a draft SMS campaign. Choose the audience via sourceType: 'all_contacts' or 'contact_list' (your own contacts), 'phones' (bring your own list — raw numbers you pass in), 'platform' (the wider Neuron audience — budget required, sent over the bulk campaign route), or 'curated' (SMS-opted-in marketplace lists via poolEntryIds; the list owner earns ₦2/contact). After creating, call neuron_estimate_sms_campaign to price it, then neuron_send_sms_campaign. Requires SMS to be enabled by an admin and a configured provider.

budget.description: Budget in kobo (required for sourceType 'platform'; caps how many messages send)

countryCodes.description: Restrict to these country calling codes (e.g. ['234']). Omit for all.

message.description: The SMS text to send. Include an opt-out (e.g. 'Reply STOP').

phones.description: Raw phone numbers to text (required when sourceType is 'phones'); normalized + de-duplicated server-side, invalid ones dropped

poolEntryIds.description: SMS-enabled list-pool entry UUIDs (required when sourceType is 'curated'; find them with neuron_browse_list_pool { smsEnabled: true })

smsChannelId.description: BYOK SMS channel UUID to send through instead of the platform provider

sourceListIds.description: Contact list UUIDs (required when sourceType is 'contact_list')

type.description: 'blast' sends to everyone at once (default); 'drip' sends in scheduled batches

name: neuron_create_sms_campaign
title: Create SMS Campaign
